platform.name: Megan APIs
platform.description: A developer-first REST API platform with 890+ endpoints covering AI chat, media downloads, social media tools, image processing, OSINT, security, and more. Powered by Megan Tech.
platform.creator: Tracker Wanga, Megan Tech

authentication.how_to_get: Create an account at apis.megan.qzz.io → Dashboard → API Keys → Generate New Key
authentication.usage: Add &api_key=YOUR_KEY to any request, or use x-api-key header

rate_limits.policy: Advisory — no hard blocks on most endpoints
rate_limits.monitoring: Usage is tracked per key. Unusual patterns trigger warnings, not blocks.

beginner_concepts.api: An API is a way for two pieces of software to talk to each other. When you call an endpoint, you're asking a server to do something and send back a result.
beginner_concepts.rest: REST is a common style of API that uses URLs and HTTP methods (GET, POST, etc.) to interact with resources.
beginner_concepts.api_key: An API key is a unique code that identifies you when you make requests. It's like a password for your app.
beginner_concepts.github: GitHub is a website where developers store and share code. Many hosting platforms deploy directly from GitHub.
beginner_concepts.deployment: Deployment means putting your project online so other people can use it.
beginner_concepts.frontend_backend: Frontend is what users see (websites, apps). Backend is the server-side logic and data. APIs usually connect the two.
